recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No current FHIR-core follow-up is needed unless DataElement or another active artifact is later reintroduced with the old misspelling.
issue_request: FHIR-6898 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core DataElement technical correction from the 2015May ballot. It requested changing "only be one repetion" to "only be one repetition" in the DataElement definitions page.
initial_application: Git commit 71f684ddfc5532e75f3887c48e4dd15393362964 already applied the correction in source/dataelement/dataelement-spreadsheet.xml, with a message naming issue 6898 and a patch changing "repetion" to "repetition". Retained historical release profiles now contain the corrected phrase.
additional_context: DataElement is outside the current build: source/fhir.ini comments out the DataElement resource, work-group, TLA, and old mapping entries; source/dataelement is absent; and source/history.html records DataElement as a removed resource. Searches of current FHIR source and the FHIR Extension Pack found no remaining "repetion" spelling. Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant contrary discussion. FHIR-21426 surfaced only as a separate FHIR-sdc issue sharing the phrase "SDC #115" and was not part of this core DataElement typo decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The old DataElement typo targeted by FHIR-6898 is already corrected wherever the old wording is retained, and the authoritative current FHIR-core build no longer includes the DataElement resource source.

related_jiras.note: Found by an "SDC #115" Jira search hit, but it is a separate FHIR-sdc issue and does not affect the FHIR-core DataElement spelling correction.
